title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin holding steady at $73,905—flat overnight, but extreme fear gripping markets. Fear & Greed at 23. That's capitulation territory.

On-chain picture looks healthy underneath. Hashrate powering through at 959 EH/s—miners aren't panicking despite price stagnation. Mempool's clear with 70k transactions backed up, fastest confirmation at just 7 sat/vB. Network's humming.

Key tension: we're stuck in a holding pattern. No explosive volume, no clear directional conviction
